I'd like to stay within a sensible budget, what are my best options?
If you’re trying to keep things budget-friendly with us, here are some solid options:
Gift cards: You can buy smaller amounts (£10, £25) so you don’t overspend at once.
Klarna (orders £60+): Either Pay in 3 instalments or Pay in 30 days to spread the cost.
Cobrand / bulk orders:
Minimum 30 units per size and color (90 for full wrap), which helps keep the unit cost (including UK/EU/CH delivery) predictable.
Just note samples cost £60/€60 each, so they’re best if you’re pretty serious about a bigger order.
Payment flexibility: We accept a wide range of cards and wallets (Visa, Mastercard, AMEX, Apple Pay, Google Pay, etc.), so you can use whichever works best with your personal budgeting or rewards setup.
So, if you want to stay on a sensible budget, smaller-value gift cards and Klarna’s instalment options are your best bet for spreading or limiting spend, while bulk orders with included delivery help keep per-unit costs under control.
